interpretations.text: Net revenue grew while contribution declined slightly and contribution margin narrowed. Revenue growth alone therefore gives an incomplete view of this scenario's commercial performance. Contribution is before advertising, fixed overhead and tax.

Paid Search had a lower contribution margin in the second half alongside higher discounting and returned-unit rates. These conditions were deliberately seeded in the synthetic data. Their coexistence motivates investigation but does not establish how much any individual factor caused the change.

The reporting dataset excludes quarantined source rows and retains their exception evidence. Passing reconciliation establishes internal consistency of accepted records, not completeness of an external source system.

recommendations.text: Ask the commercial analyst to review Paid Search promotion rules, product mix and return reasons before changing discount policy. Add campaign spend and return-disposition data before estimating campaign profitability or recoverable product costs.

Report contribution and contribution margin alongside revenue at each performance review. Separate a proposed controlled promotion test from the retrospective pattern shown here, and measure its results before claiming an improvement.

Have the data steward resolve the quarantine log and confirm upstream control totals. Retain numerical verification and manual prose review when drafting future AI-assisted reports; measure preparation and review effort before estimating time savings.
